# Tresor v0.1.1-beta.12

## Release
- Channel: beta
- Previous version: 0.1.1-beta.11
- Commit range: v0.1.1-beta.11..HEAD
- Rollout guidance: Preview release for evaluation only; expect follow-up changes before stable rollout.

## Summary
Wartungsrelease mit gezielten Korrekturen seit v0.1.1-beta.11.

## Highlights
- Cargo-deny now blocks unmaintained advisories at the direct workspace boundary without failing PRs on Tauri's transitive GTK3 notices.
- The Rust CI workspace test step now has an explicit timeout so a stuck test cannot consume the full job window without a clear failure.
- PR change detection now has the minimal pull-request read permission it needs, and the crypto architecture wording avoids a secret-scan false positive.
- Release automation now keeps Cargo.lock workspace package entries synchronized during version bumps.
- fix: complete release console checks cleanly
- fix: stabilize diagnostic smoke preflight
- fix: harden release preflight checks
- chore(runner): add Windows service enablement script for self-hosted runner
- fix(runner-routing): preserve JSON variable values via stdin

## Breaking changes
None.

## Migration hints
None.

## Validation
- Frontend CI will re-run `npm run lint`, `npm run test`, and `npm run build` on the release tag.
- Rust CI will re-run `cargo check --workspace` and `npm run test:rust` on the release tag.
- Draft release packaging remains automatic; public publishing is a separate manual review gate.
